$doc: The Alive Kit registry — ADR-0009 §1. The ONLY source any surface reads for companion availability. Invariant: advertised ⇔ status === 'verified', and 'verified' requires receipts recorded in the same commit.

capabilities.title: Trailer — a shareable 30–45s film of the explainer, from its own assets

receipts.costNotes: render + media $0 (local FFmpeg, no cloud, no paid media); authoring ~$3-4 API or ~$0 on a Claude subscription session
receipts.proof: agentic-kit pilot — embedded live at https://agentic-kit-explainer.netlify.app (hero-trailer block), WCAG 38/38, 7-beat contact sheet eyeballed

capabilities.title: Deck — the explainer reborn as a navigable pitch deck
capabilities.engine: HyperFrames /slideshow from the page's ladder sections
capabilities.verification: one supervised run on an exemplary build; every slide screenshot graded on the page grader's craft axes at >= the ship floor, worst slide judged; receipts recorded here in the promoting commit

capabilities.title: PR-to-video — an 'explain this release' film from any pull request
capabilities.engine: HyperFrames /pr-to-video on a PR of the subject repo
capabilities.verification: one supervised run on a real merged PR; worst-frame legibility check passes and the film's claims are diffed against the actual PR diff; receipts recorded here

capabilities.title: Social loop — a ≤10s motion loop of the page's hero animation
capabilities.verification: one supervised run; worst-frame check passes in BOTH aspect ratios (16:9 + 9:16); receipts recorded here
